# M18-S7 unit C companion: a variable-length region allocation that escape
# analysis proves frame-local but that cannot live on the stack must land in
# the frame region.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena

cd m
logos build -gcflags=-m -o $WORK/placenostack$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.go:.*placed in region'
logos run .
stdout '^sum 524800$'
stdout '^bytes true$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/regionplacenostack

go 1.27

-- m/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
	"logos/rt"
)

func build(n int) (int, bool) {
	r := arena.Open()
	s := arena.Make[int](r, n)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = i + 1
	}
	total := 0
	for _, v := range s {
		total += v
	}
	inside := rt.RegionBytes() > 0
	_ = r
	return total, inside
}

func main() {
	total, inside := build(1024)
	fmt.Println("sum", total)
	fmt.Println("bytes", inside)
}
